name: Nomenclature

subjectOf.text: Through fair launch evolution and continuous practice improvements, the fair launch industry and the underlying digital asset businesses can become the foundation of the emerging decentralized digital asset economy.
subjectOf.abstract: Through fair launch evolution and continuous practice improvements, the fair launch industry and underlying digital asset businesses can become the foundation of the emerging decentralized digital asset economy.

subjectOf.text: No truly uniform definition of blockchain technology exists; commentators variously describe it as a giant distributed immutable spreadsheet for transactions or by enumerating central elements such as decentralization, immutability, and cryptographic verification.
subjectOf.abstract: No truly uniform definition exists for blockchain technology. Some refer to it as a giant worldwide, distributed, immutable "google spreadsheet" for transactions.1
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Securities Versus Utility Tokens (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4021599

subjectOf.text: The core distinguishing features of blockchain technology are only generically definitional: they characterize the technology as a class but supply no specific definitions usable for classification.
subjectOf.abstract: The core distinguishing features of blockchain technology help define the technology generically but provide no specific definitions. For example, the technology's distributed consensus
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Securities Versus Utility Tokens (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4021599

subjectOf.text: The lack of a clearly delineated nomenclature for the term securities token has produced divergent uses and interpretations of that term, especially in relation to the term utility token.
subjectOf.abstract: The lack of a clearly delineated nomenclature for the term "securities token" resulted in various uses and interpretations of the term securities token, especially vis-à-vis the term "utility token."
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Securities Versus Utility Tokens (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4021599
scope_conditions: United States digital asset markets as of 2022

subjectOf.text: The term securities token is fairly well defined as of 2022, and additional regulatory guidance will continue to delineate its central features and distinguishing characteristics.
subjectOf.abstract: The term securities token is fairly well defined in 2022 and any additional regulatory guidance will continue to delineate its central features and distinguishing characteristics.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Securities Versus Utility Tokens (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4021599
scope_conditions: as of 2022; assumes continued regulatory guidance
